release_summary: A playtest with fixes and speed-ups from playing 0.11.86. No addon now works on every frame unless you are moving, sizing, sorting or selecting something: rom weakauras 0.9.28 makes about 98% less garbage per second (measured with 1 and with 15 buffs), and pbInfo, Ultimate Mail Mod, zBag, Cherry's Grid and KittyCombo check a few times a second instead. Cherry's Chat 0.10.10 no longer freezes the game when a burst of lines arrives (raising a skill to the maximum and confirming) and gets a working scroll bar with a new graphic. rom weakauras' scale corner works without a key and its Position section is open; the Target health aura shows the percentage above the bar and the HP number inside it, learned the way pbInfo does. Ultimate Mail Mod 7.0.1-ck9 caps gold presets at 999,999,999 with commas while you type and asks before resetting your character list. Addon LoadTimes 1.3.0 is now a troubleshooting addon: it stays off and uses no memory until its Switch.txt turns it on, and hub 0.4.22 no longer bundles it. Cherry's Quests 1.0.0 is included unchanged.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 681 tests; 636 passed, 26 retired-editor tests skipped and 19 PowerShell-only tests skipped because the build host had no PowerShell (CI runs them). The 35 tests added since 0.11.86 cover the chat redraw rate during bursts and the new scroll bar, the rom weakauras scale corner and grip tooltips, target HP learned by name, level and class (including the game's empty answer for monsters), the percent-above layout and description update, Past second codes without garbage, pbInfo's tooltip, cast bar, cast time and player-search rates, the idle mail master frame, UMM's gold preset grouping and cap and the reset confirmation, KittyCombo's protected control frame, and the LoadTimes switch (off, on, broken and after Reload UI). In host-side Lua measurements, the memory rom weakauras makes per 10 simulated seconds fell from about 2.8 MB to 45 KB with one buff and from 4.6 MB to 90 KB with 15 buffs and 6 debuffs; these are not client frame rates. The real client's per-frame cost, the chat freeze, the scroll bar graphics, hiding the cast bar without a flash, tooltip refreshes and the target HP numbers still need the in-game checks in docs/TESTING.md. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and byte-identical files.
